The '''Trade Federation Outpost''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] owned by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The [[Miners Alliance]] would purchase resources from [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who docked with this outpost.
